name: Instagram Business
description: Instagram is a photo and video platform for sharing media and connecting with audiences. Relay connects one Business or Creator professional account through Instagram Login and lets agents inspect its bounded identity, ten recent owned-media summaries, and one ownership-checked media item.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Business or Creator professional account with exactly instagram_business_basic through Relay-owned Instagram Login. Agents can read bounded account identity, list one page of at most ten owned-media summaries, and inspect one ownership-checked media item; publishing, engagement, messages, people data, insights, ads, tagging, discovery, shopping, media bytes, webhooks, moderation, deletion, pagination, export, and raw Graph access are blocked.

credentialRequirements: Relay-owned Meta app ID configured only on Railway
Relay-owned Meta app secret retained only by Railway
One encrypted Instagram User access-token reference
